messages.Локальные и частные сети — напрямую, кро: Local and private networks bypass VPN, except profile DNS.
messages.До 30 последних стабильных релизов из Gi: Up to 30 recent stable releases from GitHub.
messages.При повреждении файла профили восстанавл: Damaged profiles are automatically recovered from a valid backup. Manual recovery is a fallback for unwanted changes or deleted profiles.
Release notes have not been published.
messages.Профили восстановлены из резервной копии: Profiles recovered from backup. The damaged file was preserved separately.
messages.Файл профилей повреждён. Исходные данные: Profile file damaged. Original data preserved; open recovery settings.
messages.Файл профилей повреждён; исходные данные: The profile file is damaged; original data was preserved. Import profiles or restore a backup.
messages.Отчёт не содержит ключей, адресов сервер: The report excludes keys, server addresses, captcha URLs and raw logs. It does not perform a live VPN test.
messages.Заменить список профилей последней резер: Replace profiles with the last backup? Disconnect first.
messages.VPN работает · ошибка нового подключения: VPN is working · new connection failed
messages.VPN работает · требуется проверка VK: VPN is working · VK verification required
messages.Сохранённый профиль недоступен. Проверьт: The saved profile is unavailable. Check the startup connection profile.
messages.По умолчанию клиент сначала пробует авто: By default, the client tries automatic solving first and opens the window only when manual verification is needed. Enabling this option skips the automatic attempt. Verification needs no camera or microphone and does not restart working streams.
VK verification is required to connect.
messages.Применяется сразу. «Как в системе» автом: Applies immediately. System default automatically follows the light or dark OS theme.
messages.Ссылка на звонок VK Calls из профиля: VK Calls link included in the profile
messages.Владелец включил эту ссылку в профиль. О: The owner included this link in the profile. It will be saved on import; you can change it in the profile settings.
messages.DNS-режим реле и подготовки VPN. При под: DNS mode for the relay and VPN preparation. During preparation, Auto uses system DNS or custom resolvers, with DoH on failure. Plain and doh do not switch modes. Does not replace DNS in the WireGuard configuration.
messages.Домены разрешаются при подключении согла: Domains are resolved when connecting according to the profile DNS mode. Auto tries system DNS or custom resolvers first, then DoH on failure. Reconnect after IP changes. Use exact names without https://, paths or *. Add subdomains separately. Sites sharing an IP may match the same rule; browser DNS/DoH may resolve different IPs. Rules only cover WireGuard AllowedIPs ranges: an IPv4-only configuration does not cover IPv6. Profile DNS servers keep their service VPN routes even when blacklisted.
messages.Команда строится по сохранённому профилю: The command uses the saved profile and may contain keys and links. Do not publish it.
messages.Ключ для входа по SSH, не ключ WireGuard: SSH login key, not a WireGuard key. Do not publish its contents.
messages.Пароль защиты SSH-ключа. Если ключ без п: SSH key protection passphrase. Leave empty for an unencrypted key.
messages.Пароль SSH-пользователя на VPS. Не парол: VPS SSH user password. Not a VK password or VPN profile key.
messages.Нужен только для повышения прав через su: Only needed for sudo elevation. Usually not required for root login.
messages.Нет запущенного поддерживаемого контейне: No supported running container is available. Unknown installations are not reconfigured, and stopped containers are not started automatically.
messages.Конфигурация для отдельного WireGuard-кл: Configuration for an external WireGuard client
messages.Удалить локальный профиль «{name}»? Серв: Delete local profile “{name}”? The VPS server and its users will not be removed.
messages.Порт входа по SSH, обычно 22. Это не пор: SSH login port, usually 22. This is not the VPN or TURN relay port.
messages.SSH-пользователь VPS, например root. Это: VPS SSH user, for example root. This is not a VK account or Client ID.
messages.Используйте пароль SSH или приватный клю: Use an SSH password or OpenSSH private key. Do not share these login details with profile users.
messages.Можно выбрать предложенный адрес или вве: Choose a suggested endpoint or enter a custom domain and port. This changes only the local profile, not VPS settings.
messages.Выберите работающий поддерживаемый экзем: Choose a supported running instance. Unknown or stopped containers are not modified automatically.
messages.Сохраните префикс desktop-. Допустимы ла: Keep the desktop- prefix. Use letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, up to 32 characters. Retrying the same name retrieves its issued profile.
messages.Удаляется только профиль в приложении: Only the local app profile is removed
messages.В профиле нет WireGuard-конфига. Для VPN: This profile has no WireGuard configuration. Import a complete link with configuration for one-click VPN; relay mode is currently available.
messages.Перезапустить сервер? Подключения других: Restart the server? Other devices may be disconnected.
messages.Остановить сервер для всех его клиентов?: Stop the server for all its clients?
messages.Удаление общей установки из клиента откл: Removing a shared installation from the client is disabled to protect other devices.
messages.Применяется сразу. Режим «Как в системе»: Applies immediately. System default follows the operating system language.
messages.Одна попытка при запуске приложения. Про: One attempt when the app starts. VK verification may require user action; reconnect manually after a failure.
messages.Используется только при запуске приложен: Used only at app startup. Disabling auto-connect does not remove the selected profile.
messages.Подключается другой профиль. Дождитесь з: Another profile is connecting. Wait for completion or cancel the attempt.
messages.Встроенный VPN сам создаёт сетевой интер: Built-in VPN creates the network interface itself. Relay mode is for an external WireGuard/AmneziaWG client.
messages.Название только для списка профилей. Оно: A name for your profile list only. It does not change the server.
messages.Публичный адрес реле и его порт: домен:п: Public relay address and port: domain:port or IP:port. A domain with an up-to-date DNS record is preferable when the IP can change.
messages.В VK Звонках создайте звонок и скопируйт: Create a call in VK Calls and copy its invitation link. Do not end the call. Paste one link per line. Each link receives the stream count configured below; blank lines do not count. Do not publish links in public logs.
messages.Маскировка включена: проверьте ключ из п: Obfuscation is enabled: check the key from the server profile.
messages.Должен совпадать с профилем маскировки н: Must match server obfuscation. It normally needs no changes after importing a link.
messages.64 шестнадцатеричных символа, как на сер: 64 hexadecimal characters matching the server. Use the issued key for an existing server: generating a random key does not update the server.
messages.Дополнительная задержка отправки пакетов: Additional obfuscated-packet send delay. It adds latency and does not guarantee bypassing restrictions; 0 disables it.
messages.Соединение клиента с TURN-сервером: TCP: Client-to-TURN connection: TCP or UDP. This does not select WireGuard transport or the SSH port.
messages.Должен совпадать с режимом реле на серве: Must match the server relay mode. TCP mode uses the additional KCP settings.
messages.Локальный адрес реле для отдельного Wire: Local relay address for an external WireGuard client. Built-in VPN uses an internal channel instead of this UDP port.
messages.Режим задержки KCP. Меняйте только при о: KCP delay mode. Change only when deliberately tuning transport.
messages.Размер пакета KCP, не MTU интерфейса Wir: KCP packet size, not the WireGuard interface MTU.
messages.Способ разрешения имён самим реле: auto,: How the relay resolves names: automatic, plain DNS or DNS-over-HTTPS. It does not replace DNS in the WireGuard configuration.
messages.Необязательный список резолверов клиента: Optional client resolvers. Leaving this empty keeps the core defaults.
messages.Идентификатор доступа к реле. Он должен: Relay access identifier. It must be authorized on the server; generating a new one does not register it automatically.
Lets the user handle VK verification. Verification for one link should not interrupt working streams.
messages.Служебные маршруты транспорта реле. Это: Relay transport service routes. These are not the website routing lists below.
messages.Включайте для диагностики. Перед публика: Enable for diagnostics. Remove keys, Client IDs, call links and device identifiers before sharing logs.
messages.Это действия на удалённом сервере, а не: These actions affect the remote server, not just one local profile. Stopping or restarting may interrupt other devices.
messages.Содержит приватный ключ. Не публикуйте э: Contains a private key. Do not publish this configuration or a screenshot of it.
messages.Изменения применяются после сохранения п: Changes take effect after saving the profile and reconnecting.
messages.Число потоков задаётся на каждую ссылку: Streams are configured per VK Calls link. The total is this value multiplied by the number of non-empty links. Increasing it does not guarantee more speed: TURN and VK limits still apply.
messages.Как распределяются потоки по аккаунтам: How streams are grouped by account
messages.На каждой ссылке потоки независимо делят: Each link independently groups streams sharing TURN credentials (VK sessions). This value cannot exceed streams per link. The last group may be partial; adding links does not increase this limit.
messages.Расчётных групп на ссылку: {perLink}; вс: Planned groups per link: {perLink}; total: {total}. This is not a count of accounts actually signed in.
messages.Добавьте ссылку VK Calls для расчёта общ: Add a VK Calls link to calculate the total stream count.
messages.Сохранённые расширенные значения не умен: Saved extended values are not reduced when opening the profile.
messages.Для сервера с меняющимся IP используйте: For a server with a changing IP, use a domain and keep its DNS record up to date.
messages.Проверьте адрес реле перед сохранением п: Review the relay address before saving the profile. The server configuration may contain an outdated address.
The link address differs from the SSH address. This can be intentional (NAT or a separate public address); choose the appropriate endpoint.
messages.Меняется только локальный профиль. Парам: Only the local profile is changed. Container settings and keys are not modified.
messages.При входе в систему. Автоподключение нас: When signing in. Automatic connection is configured separately below.
Existing FreeTurn container found. Add a separate device profile without reinstalling, updating or restarting the server.
messages.Имя устройства (desktop- и латиница, циф: Device name (desktop- followed by letters, digits, . _ -)
messages.Домены разрешаются через системный DNS п: Domains are resolved using system DNS at connection time; reconnect if their IPs change. Use exact names without https://, paths or *. Add subdomains separately. Sites sharing an IP may match the same rule; browser DNS/DoH may resolve different IPs. Rules only cover WireGuard AllowedIPs ranges: an IPv4-only configuration does not cover IPv6. Profile DNS servers keep their service VPN routes even when blacklisted.
messages.SSH следует маршрутам профиля: для досту: SSH follows profile routes: include the VPS address in VPN routes to reach it through the VPN. For a private address, also disable local network bypass. The relay's own connections use the physical interface. This is routing, not blocking or leak protection.
messages.При входе в Windows. Автоподключение нас: When signing in to Windows. Automatic connection is configured separately below.
messages.Обнаружен установленный сервер. Повторна: An existing server was detected. Reinstallation and reconfiguration are disabled.
messages.Укажите параметры существующего подключе: Enter the existing connection settings and its client configuration. Saving only adds a local profile: server settings and authorized clients will not change.
messages.Соединение работает. Для части потоков т: The connection is active. Some streams require VK verification.
messages.Для подключения требуется проверка VK в: VK verification in the browser is required to connect.
messages.ICMP до адреса сервера, примерно раз в 5: ICMP to the server address, approximately every 5 seconds. This is not the latency of the entire VPN tunnel. Uses the current system routes. If ICMP is blocked or ping is unavailable, ‘—’ is shown.
Unsaved changes will be lost. Continue?
messages.Выберите сервер слева или добавьте новый: Select a server on the left or add a new one to connect via free-turn-proxy.
messages.freeturn:// ссылка от владельца сервера: freeturn:// link from the server owner
messages.В ссылке есть WireGuard-конфиг — после и: The link includes a WireGuard configuration — connect with one click after import (built-in VPN).
messages.WireGuard-конфига в ссылке нет — будет р: No WireGuard configuration in the link — relay mode requires a separate WireGuard/AmneziaWG client.
messages.Нажмите, чтобы подключиться к выбранному: Click to connect to the selected server
messages.Добавьте первый сервер, чтобы начать: Add your first server to get started
messages.Пароль sudo (если отличается от пароля в: Sudo password (if different from login password)
messages.Ваша ссылка на звонок VK Calls (можно до: Your VK Calls link (can be added later)
messages.Развернём free-turn-proxy и интерфейс Wi: We will deploy free-turn-proxy and the WireGuard interface (ft-wg0), start them with obfuscation and add you as the first authorized client.
messages.Конфиг WireGuard/AmneziaWG для отдельног: WireGuard/AmneziaWG configuration for an external client (Endpoint already points to the local relay)
messages.При входе в сеанс Linux. Автоподключение: When signing in to Linux. Automatic connection is configured separately below.
messages.Одна попытка при каждом запуске приложен: One attempt on each application launch, including at login.
messages.Капча может потребовать ручного ввода. П: Captcha may require manual input. If the connection fails, try again manually.
messages.Закрытие окна не прерывает соединение. В: Closing the window keeps the connection active. Quit using the tray menu.
messages.Системный трей недоступен. В GNOME нужно: System tray unavailable. GNOME requires an AppIndicator / KStatusNotifierItem extension. Without a tray, closing the window exits the app and disconnects the VPN.
messages.Скачано / отдано пользователем с момента: User download / upload since WireGuard started on the server
messages.Ссылка слишком длинная для QR-кода — отп: The link is too long for a QR code — send it as text.
messages.Отправьте ссылку или покажите QR: пользо: Send the link or show the QR code: importing it into the app adds the server with a working WireGuard configuration.
The user will enter their own VK call link.
messages.VPN-режим в одну кнопку доступен только: One-click VPN is available for servers deployed with “New VPS”, which generates a WireGuard configuration. Only relay mode is available for this server.
messages.Сейчас подключён другой сервер — переклю: Another server is connected — switching will disconnect it first.
messages.Направьте на этот адрес Endpoint в вашем: Set this as the Endpoint in your WireGuard/AmneziaWG client (relay configuration, MTU 1280), then enable VPN.
messages.Автоматические маршруты к TURN-серверам: Automatic TURN server routes (administrator authorization required)
messages.Удалить free-turn-proxy и управляемый Wi: Remove free-turn-proxy and the managed WireGuard interface from this VPS? The profile in the app will be kept.
messages.Конфиг WireGuard/AmneziaWG для отдельног: WireGuard/AmneziaWG configuration for an external client
messages.Репозиторий обновлений не задан при сбор: No update repository configured in this build. Set UPDATE_REPOSITORY for local builds.
messages.Сразу после запуска, затем каждые 6 часо: Immediately after launch, then every 6 hours using the public GitHub API. Checks run in the background.
messages.Архив проверен по SHA-256 и сохранён:: Archive verified with SHA-256 and saved:
messages.Белый список: только указанные адреса че: Whitelist: only listed addresses use VPN. Blacklist: listed addresses bypass VPN. Whitelists are combined; blacklist exclusions take priority. With no enabled whitelist, the full profile AllowedIPs range is used. Rules apply only to the built-in VPN, not relay mode or the separate CLI client.
messages.Домены, IP и подсети — по одной записи в: Domains, IPs and subnets — one entry per line
messages.Домены разрешаются через системный DNS п: Domains are resolved using system DNS at connection time; reconnect if their IPs change. Use exact names without https://, paths or *. Add subdomains separately. Sites sharing an IP may match the same rule; browser DNS/DoH may resolve different IPs. Rules only cover WireGuard AllowedIPs ranges: an IPv4-only configuration does not cover IPv6. Profile DNS servers keep their service VPN routes even when blacklisted. On Linux, SSH follows profile routes: include the VPS address in VPN routes to reach it through the VPN. The relay's own connections use the physical interface. This is routing, not blocking or leak protection.
Up to 16 lists and 256 entries per profile. Save and reconnect to apply.
messages.Изменение списков недоступно, пока этот: Lists cannot be edited while this profile is connected.
messages.Получаем информацию о последнем стабильн: Fetching the latest stable release information.

Waiting for the GitHub download server.
messages.VPN продолжает работать до завершения по: VPN stays connected until preparation is complete.
messages.Архив скачан. Проверяем целостность и со: Archive downloaded. Verifying integrity and saving the file.
messages.Проверяем состав архива и архитектуру. У: Checking archive contents and architecture. Installed files are not changed yet.

messages.При входе в macOS. Автоподключение настр: When signing in to macOS. Automatic connection is configured separately below.
messages.Системный трей недоступен. Пока трей нед: System tray unavailable. Without a tray, closing the window exits the app and disconnects the VPN.
messages.После скачивания закройте FreeTurn и зам: After downloading, quit FreeTurn and replace the app in Applications.
